meta.note: Base phase, rebuilt 2026-08-17 around the Amazon night shift (Wed-Sat 6:30pm-5am, from Aug 26). Three runs a week on the free days, peak 18.5 mpw. The formal 19-week marathon block starts 2026-12-07, the week the job ends, and gets built from the week-16 test.

foundation.notes: Real running background (sub-6 HS mile) but zero current run volume. Muscular build at 5'5"/190lb. Engine is well ahead of connective-tissue readiness — that gap is the whole risk.

strengths.evidence: sub-6 HS mile; 8:40/mi off zero training

limiters.evidence: no current run volume; tendon/bone adapts 12-24wk

constraints: Amazon warehouse nights Wed-Sat 6:30pm-5am, Aug 26 - Dec 2026
Free to train: Sun (post-shift), Mon, Tue
Slept under six hours -> walk, do not run

targets.note: Locked in Feb/Mar 2027 off actual long-run and tempo data, per handoff.

weightPlan.protein: 180-200 g/day throughout — the deficit is long, protein is what keeps it muscle-sparing
weightPlan.note: 165-168 by race day is realistic if the cut is front-loaded into the base phase while mileage is low. Do not run a deficit in the taper: racing glycogen-depleted costs more minutes than the pounds save.

phases.name: Base
physiologicalGoals: Mitochondrial density and capillarization (the 4-12 week adaptations)
Tendon and bone loading tolerance (the 12-24 week adaptation — the real constraint)

weeks.focus: Establish the shape. Run/walk only — the walk breaks are the point, not a concession.
